synergy_contract: RALPH must remain sufficient when /goal is not active.
When /goal is active, treat it as the live objective and RALPH as the durable evidence controller.
Do not mark /goal complete until RALPH completion_readiness.ready is true.
Do not mark /goal blocked until RALPH records a concrete blocker or repeated no-progress loop.

recommended_goal_tool_actions.when_starting: create_goal(objective=<ralph goal>) if no active /goal exists and the user wants runtime supervision
recommended_goal_tool_actions.when_done: update_goal(status='complete') only after RALPH completion readiness is true
recommended_goal_tool_actions.when_blocked: update_goal(status='blocked') only after RALPH blocker evidence is durable
